hooks.name: user_defined_post_tool_audit
hooks.description: Sample user-defined PostToolUse hook — writes latency_ms to audit log for any tool that took > 5s (transform 注入 slow_tool 标志). 演示 hook 体系如何让用户添加工具, 不依赖 builtin 5 件套.

hooks.name: user_defined_session_echo
hooks.description: Sample SessionEnd hook — writes session_id + duration to ~/.multica/session-history.log (append-only). 用于让用户演示如何用 hook 拓展 session lifecycle.

hooks.name: user_defined_cron_heartbeat
hooks.description: Sample CronTick hook — writes heartbeat timestamp to audit log every tick. 演示 cron 事件接入, 用于 ULYS-236 (定时任务) 调试.
